integrity: Original analysis credits convex-hull, Caratheodory, and Laplace principles and the motivating random quadrature literature; finite checker is corroboration, not proof. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: No higher-degree moments, dependent/nonuniform sample laws, weight-conditioning bounds, or uniform-in-c asymptotics. Strict all-node positivity holds almost surely. Priority comparisons are bounded and cannot establish uniqueness.
scientific_scope: Uniform iid nodes on [-1,1]; exact nonnegative reweighting for moments 1,0,c, 0<c<1; complete all-m feasible probability and fixed-c sharp asymptotic. Based on a target with these moments, not on a fixed least-squares weight algorithm.
title: An exact two-mechanism phase transition in random positive quadratic quadrature
